newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stora says not in bidding for KNP Leykam.
newsitem.headline: Stora says not in bidding for KNP Leykam.

text.p: Swedish forestry group Stora on Wednesday denied Dutch media reports that it planned to bid for KNP Leykam, the Dutch KNP BT's loss-making Austrian fine paper unit.
"KNP Leykam is not a hot property for us, and we haven't shown any particular interest in the company," Stora spokesman Mats Aguren told Reuters.
Aguren said the report in Dutch daily De Telegraaf had reflected market rumours that both Stora and International Paper (IP) were interested in KNP Leykem.
"The industry is always looking at new ways to restructure, we're looking at all the opportunities all of the time, and I'm sure that IP are doing the same," Aguren said.
